Name: Calcifer Fireplaces (Ghibli)
Author: Sharogg
Description:
Have you ever wanted to have Calcifer in your own home? Then this mod is for you. It adds all the vanilla fireplaces with Calcifer as separate furniture items, plus an additional larger fireplace that is inspired by the fireplace in Howl's moving castle. You can get them all in the furniture catalogue or buy at Robin's. The vanilla fireplaces are called the same, but the description mentions Calcifer to make them distinguishable.

The fireplaces work the same as vanilla fireplaces, you can turn them on and off and they emit the same light. The fireball sound is played when turned on and off, however, the crackling fire ambient noise does not work, as this is currently not supported by Furniture Framework (though it may be implemented at some point and then I will add it in this mod).

[b][color=#ff0000]This does not replace any of the vanilla fireplaces or their flame animation. [/color][color=#ff0000]I will not be adding this since would be a completely different mod requiring C#.[/color][/b]
The duplicated vanilla fireplaces will not be affected by recolours and are unfortunately also not compatible with Alternative Textures as that is a limitation of the Furniture Framework.

Requires Furniture Framework. Unzip the mod and paste it into Stardew Valley's Mods folder. 1.6 and SMAPI required.
